info.title: ndui
info.description: The RATH stack for .NET — Razor, Alpine.js, Tailwind, HTMX. Installs owned, editable Razor components into your .NET 10 project from the Noundry registry.

x-inspectra.cliParsedDescription: ndui — Noundry Studio component workshop CLI.

options.name: --plain
options.description: ASCII-only output, no color, no spinners. Required for CI.

options.name: --json
options.description: Emit machine-readable JSON on stdout. Human output routes to stderr.

options.name: --verbose
options.description: Show diagnostic detail, including stack traces on failure.

options.name: --version
options.description: Show version information

options.name: -h
options.description: Show help and usage information

commands.name: init
commands.description: Scaffold a new Studio project, or initialize Studio in an existing project.

options.name: --starter-version
options.description: Starter archive version to fetch from the registry (must exist at /starter/v<version>.zip).

options.name: --registry
options.description: Registry URL to use for this init; otherwise the default public registry.

options.name: --theme
options.description: Default theme (default / slate / rose).

options.name: --no-restore
options.description: Skip `dotnet restore` after scaffold.

arguments.name: NAME
arguments.description: Project name. When provided, scaffolds a new project in ./<name>/; when omitted, initializes Studio in the current directory.

commands.name: add
commands.description: Install one or more components from the registry into the current project.

options.name: --version
options.description: Pin a specific version for the FIRST named component. Other components install at their latest. For per-component pinning, run ndui add once per component.

options.name: --yes
options.description: Skip confirmation prompt.

options.name: --overwrite
options.description: Overwrite existing component files without prompting.

options.name: --skip-deps
options.description: Install only the named components, not their dependencies.

arguments.name: NAMES
arguments.description: One or more component names to install (e.g. `datatable dialog toast`).

options.name: --category
options.description: Restrict to a category: primitives, overlays, navigation, data-display, forms, feedback, meta.

arguments.name: QUERY
arguments.description: Free-text filter. Matches against name, displayName, description, category, and tags.

commands.name: info
commands.description: Show component details (dependencies, files, preview URL).

options.name: --version
options.description: Specific version to inspect. Defaults to latestVersion from the registry index.

commands.name: diff
commands.description: Show a unified diff of an installed component against the registry version.

options.name: --against-version
options.description: Diff against a specific registry version. Defaults to the registry's latestVersion.

commands.name: update
commands.description: Update installed components. Prompts per-file with keep-mine / take-theirs / merge-tool / skip when files are modified.

options.name: --yes
options.description: Take registry version on every conflict without prompting (non-interactive).

arguments.name: NAME
arguments.description: Component to update; omit to update all.

commands.name: remove
commands.description: Remove an installed component. Refuses if other components depend on it.

options.name: --force
options.description: Remove even if other components depend on it.

commands.name: doctor
commands.description: Verify project health: DI wiring, file integrity, version consistency.

options.name: --fix
options.description: Auto-fix safe issues: missing component files, missing _ViewImports directives, missing CSS imports.

commands.name: preview
commands.description: Open the showcase page for a component in the default browser.

commands.name: theme
commands.description: Swap theme — downloads the theme CSS, updates @import, records in ndstudio.json.

options.name: --list
options.description: List available themes from the registry instead of swapping.

arguments.name: NAME
arguments.description: Theme name (default / slate / rose / <your custom>). Omit to print the current theme.

commands.name: registry
commands.description: View or change the active registry URL (supports private mirrors).

commands.name: validate
commands.description: Validate every manifest.json under a local registry directory.

commands.name: build-index
commands.description: Regenerate index.json from every manifest.json under components/.

commands.name: telemetry
commands.description: View or change your CLI telemetry preferences (opt-in, silent-drop on network failure).

commands.name: enable
commands.description: Opt in to anonymous CLI usage telemetry.

commands.name: disable
commands.description: Opt out of telemetry. Prior events are not deleted; future events are not sent.

commands.name: endpoint
commands.description: Change the telemetry endpoint (useful for pointing at a self-hosted telemetry-worker).
